issues.detail: The Hebrew says 'the survivors who were left from the captivity there in the province' (הַֽנִּשְׁאָרִ֞ים אֲשֶֽׁר נִשְׁאֲר֤וּ מִן הַשְּׁבִי֙ שָׁ֣ם בַּמְּדִינָ֔ה), meaning survivors from the exile/captivity who are in the province. The Chinese renders '那些從當地的擄掠物中倖存下來的人' ('those who survived from the local plunder/spoils'), which changes 'from the captivity/exile' (מִן הַשְּׁבִי) to 'from the plunder/spoils' (擄掠物), and adds '當地的' ('local') which is not in the Hebrew. This alters the meaning: the survivors are from the captivity, not from plunder.
